scenes.title: Getting ready for your procedure
scenes.narration: Hello Margaret. This video helps you get ready for your cataract surgery (right eye) at Brackenridge. It takes about two minutes. You can pause it, turn on captions, or ask a question at any time.
scenes.speech: Hello Margaret. This video helps you get ready for your cataract surgery (right eye) at Brackenridge. It takes about two minutes. You can pause it, turn on captions, or ask a question at any time.

scenes.title: What happens
scenes.narration: The cloudy lens in your right eye is removed and replaced with a clear artificial lens. You'll be awake. The area will be numbed, so you shouldn't feel pain. It's a day case, so you should go home the same day.
scenes.speech: The cloudy lens in your right eye is removed and replaced with a clear artificial lens. You'll be awake. The area will be numbed, so you shouldn't feel pain. It's a day case, so you should go home the same day.

scenes.title: When and where

stats.label: Where
stats.value: Eye Day Unit, Level 1, Brackenridge Community Hospital

scenes.narration: Your appointment is on Thursday 12 November. Please arrive at 8:30am. Go to the Eye Day Unit, Level 1, Brackenridge Community Hospital. Expect to be with us for about 3 hours.
scenes.speech: Your appointment is on Thursday 12 November. Please arrive at 8:30am. Go to the Eye Day Unit, Level 1, Brackenridge Community Hospital. Expect to be with us for about 3 hours.

scenes.title: Eating and drinking

visual.heading: No need to fast
visual.body: You can eat and drink normally before your appointment.

scenes.narration: Good news. You don't need to stop eating or drinking. You can have your meals as normal before you come in.
scenes.speech: Good news. You don't need to stop eating or drinking. You can have your meals as normal before you come in.

scenes.title: Your medicines

items: Keep taking your usual medicines, including eye drops, unless told otherwise.
If you take blood-thinning medicines, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.

scenes.narration: Now, your medicines. Keep taking your usual medicines, including eye drops, unless told otherwise. If you take blood-thinning medicines, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.

scenes.title: What to bring
scenes.narration: Please bring a list of your medicines, your glasses and something to read. Leave jewellery and valuables at home.
scenes.speech: Please bring a list of your medicines, your glasses and something to read. Leave jewellery and valuables at home.

scenes.title: Going home

visual.heading: Someone must take you home
visual.body: Do not drive until your eye doctor says your sight meets the legal standard.

scenes.narration: You'll need someone to take you home. Do not drive until your eye doctor says your sight meets the legal standard. Most people notice clearer sight within a few days. Use your eye drops as shown for 4 weeks.
scenes.speech: You'll need someone to take you home. Do not drive until your eye doctor says your sight meets the legal standard. Most people notice clearer sight within a few days. Use your eye drops as shown for 4 weeks.

scenes.title: When to get help

visual.heading: Call us straight away if you have:

scenes.narration: After you get home, call us straight away if you have any of these: increasing pain in the eye; your sight gets worse; increasing redness or sticky discharge.
scenes.speech: After you get home, call us straight away if you have any of these: increasing pain in the eye; your sight gets worse; increasing redness or sticky discharge.
